tools.name: terrarium_inspect
tools.description: Inspect soil moisture, current light, species requirements, history availability, plants, seeds, bugs and objects. This advances elapsed simulation time.

summary.zh: 查看生态箱的土壤、光照、物种需求和小时历史。
summary.en: Inspects soil, light, species requirements and hourly history.

tools.name: terrarium_water
tools.description: Water soil by plant id OR x and y, including seed and empty plots. Adds 35 moisture points up to 100. Water diffuses to adjacent cells over time.

summary.zh: 按植物 ID 或格子坐标给土壤浇水。
summary.en: Waters soil by plant ID or grid coordinates.

tools.name: terrarium_move
tools.description: Move the coin or pebble on the 5×5 grid. The pebble shades its cell and orthogonal neighbors, reducing daylight to 35% and slowing daytime evaporation. x and y are 0..4.

summary.zh: 移动生态箱里的硬币或石子。

tools.name: terrarium_sow
tools.description: Sow moss, basil or bean in a free plot of the 5×5 grid. Seeds sprout after two daylight hours with enough soil moisture. Plants grow within their species moisture and light ranges; inspect returns those ranges. At most 12 plants and seeds.

summary.en: Sows a seed at a plot.

tools.name: terrarium_release_bug
tools.description: Release an aphid, beetle or spider into the 5×5 grid. Aphids eat plants, beetles hunt aphids, spiders hunt other bugs. At most 12 bugs.

tools.name: terrarium_feed_bug
tools.description: Feed one bug by id, restoring 35 energy up to 100.

tools.name: terrarium_relocate_bug
tools.description: Move one bug by id to a grid cell. Bugs may share cells; predators hunt prey on their hourly step.

tools.name: terrarium_remove
tools.description: Remove a plant, seed or bug by id from the terrarium.

summary.zh: 移出指定植物、种子或虫子。

tools.name: terrarium_history
tools.description: Read hourly history for one plant (including removed or dead plants) or one soil cell. Supply plant OR x and y. Returns the latest limit samples, default 24, maximum 168. Missing plants have null values.

summary.zh: 查询一株植物或一格土壤的小时历史。
summary.en: Reads hourly history for one plant or soil cell.

description.en: The terrarium changed between day and night.

description.zh: 植物长出新阶段或土壤变干。
description.en: A plant reached a new growth stage or its soil became dry.
A seed sprouted or an organism died.
Two bugs of one species reproduced.

prompts.title: 生态箱 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
你有一个本地生态箱，可以观察、养护、播种、投放虫子、喂养与迁移虫子，也可以移出植物、种子或虫子。白天是当地时间 06:00–18:00。每格土壤有独立水分，水向上下左右相邻格渗透。白天光照从 x=0 的 0.6 逐渐增加到 x=4 的 1.0；石头使所在格及上下左右相邻格的白天光照降至原来的 35%，并降低白天蒸发。terrarium_water 按植物 ID 或格子坐标浇水，每次增加 35 水分、上限 100，也可浇种子或空地。植物只在白天且水分和光照都符合物种需求时生长，水分超出范围会损失健康；苔藓喜湿、喜阴，罗勒和豆苗需要较强光照。查看工具返回各物种的具体需求、每格水分、白天光照 daylight、当前光照 light，以及历史样本数量和时间范围。terrarium_history 按植物 ID 或格子坐标查询小时历史，默认返回最近 24 个样本，最多 168 个；死亡或移出的植物仍可查询已有记录。蚜虫吃植物，甲虫捕食蚜虫，蜘蛛捕食其他虫子。同种虫子成年后在同一格、体力足够时可能繁殖。启用排行榜上报时，生态箱状态会上传排行榜，分数依据植物阶段、健康、水分及虫子状态计算。
收到土壤变干、虫子体力低、捕食、繁殖或生物死亡事件时，可以用 terrarium_inspect 查看当前状态，再自行决定是否操作。播种位置是 5×5 网格中的空地。

changelog.0.4.0:
- Default to https://cortico-box.zhiyuhub.top and request credentials when no token is configured.
- Persist issued credentials per service and box ID across client and server restarts.

- Add per-cell soil moisture, water diffusion and pebble shade.
- Give plant species distinct moisture and daylight requirements.
- Add hourly soil and plant history, a history query tool and WebUI charts.
- Migrate state versions 1 and 2 to version 3 on load; the next save writes version 3. Older versions cannot read the new state.
- Accept legacy leaderboard reports and reports with seven days of history.
changelog.0.3.0:
- Let the bot feed and relocate bugs and remove plants, seeds or bugs.
- Let mature, well-fed bug pairs reproduce when they share a cell.
- Deliver hunt, birth, hunger and death events so the bot can inspect and respond.
changelog.0.2.2:
- Keep bugs visible on the soil surface and separate bugs sharing a cell.
- Animate only actual moves; preserve movement across unchanged reports.
- Disable public scene caching so renderer updates reach visitors.
changelog.0.2.1:
- Share one Canvas renderer between the World panel and public leaderboard.
- Refresh the World panel every five seconds and animate bug movement and hunts.
changelog.0.2.0:
- Add sowing, bug behavior, hunting and ecosystem events.
- Add an optional authenticated leaderboard service and public Canvas gallery.
- Migrate existing terrarium state to the 5×5 ecosystem format.
changelog.0.1.0:
- Add a persistent two-plant terrarium with day and night changes.
- Add inspection, watering, and object movement tools.
- Show the terrarium in a WebUI panel.
